additional_info.subject: ID0417978-DC/Si-D/IT[ThvN5S] - OCPP offline CRM:00315002534
additional_info.body:
Hi Luigi, good morning.
After the reboot, the connection was reestablished. Since the router was completely offline we cannot ascertain the root cause because the logs of the router are not present.
From our side the issue has been resolved. If this problem occurs many times, we need to send the service technicians to perform troubleshooting on site.
I will proceed to close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
